rv.q: For anyone who remembers the movie—or just enjoys this era of music—Mystic Pizza makes for an enjoyable evening at the Ordway.
The audience at the Ordway seemed to be thoroughly enjoying themselves, as were my companion and myself.
For an undeniably joyful evening packed with anthems you already know by heart, get to the Ordway before the weekend wraps.
Consistently well-sung and acted, it proved a very enjoyable evening.

cn.t: This '80s nostalgia musical adaptation serves up an engaging, affable slice of pop entertainment with strong performances from its three leads and fluid staging, though it remains a modest crowd-pleaser rather than essential theater.
